_comment: Copy to dev.json / staging.json / prod.json and fill in from the CDK
None of these are secrets. A Cognito pool id and public client id are
designed to be embedded in a distributed app, and the API URL is public.
They are kept out of git so one environment's config cannot end up in
Do NOT add anything genuinely secret here. A mobile binary is not a
place secrets can be kept — anything shipped in one is readable.
_tile_url: Map tile endpoint. Leave unset for local development and the app falls
back to a public CARTO CDN. That fallback sends the on-screen viewport --
which on the patient detail screen is centred on a patient -- to a third
party with no BAA. Release builds REQUIRE this to be set to a tile server
_demo_seed: Set to true ONLY for demo builds. Never in a build that will hold real records.
